requirements: R1: The internal system must accurately transition tasks away from 'done' status when their associated GitHub PR is closed without being merged.

slices.title: Patch GitHub sync to handle unmerged closed PRs
slices.jtbd: When implementing the GitHub status sync patch for this epic, I want to properly identify unmerged closed PRs and revert their internal status, so that task accuracy is maintained.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an internal task previously marked 'done' based on an open PR,
When the GitHub PR is subsequently closed without a merge action,
Then the internal task status must be reverted to an open or failed state.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease the incidence of tasks falsely marked as done due to closed-unmerged PRs to zero
